name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 15
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #391

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category 
  
 #wtrl #wtrlttt

We encourage everyone to stay together for this social ride. Every ride completion will help UNICEF vaccinate a child against polio.

About Vitality:
 
Guided by a core purpose of making people healthier, Vitality is the leader in shared-value by creating healthy behavior changes in insurance. By blending technology, data, incentives, and behavioural science, Vitality inspires healthy changes in individuals and organizations. 

In partnership with UNICEF, Vitality aims to vaccinate millions of children against polio by donating vaccines on behalf of participants who complete the Vitality for UNICEF Ride series events.

Furthermore, the partnership with Zwift has been established as part of Vitality’s global pledge to get 100 million people 20% more active by 2025 through incentives to live healthier, more active lifestyles.

name: Zwift Women's Training Club Workout
description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way! 

Join the Zwift Women’s Training Club to connect with new ride friends, ask questions, and get advice from experts.  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ZwiftWTC/join

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides every 3 hours on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays in addition to the Tuesday/Thursday workouts.

name: ZTPL Cycling Club & Slask Kolarsko Training PTK
description:
ZTPL Cycling Club wspólnie z Śląsk Kolarsko zaprasza na wspólny cykl cotygodniowych treningów.
Celem naszych spotkań będzie świadome i efektywne przepracowanie okresu zimowego,
tak aby stworzyć solidne fundamenty fizjologiczne pod kolejny sezon kolarski.

Nasza jazda odbywać się będzie w formie #GroupWorkout co oznacza, że wszyscy jedziemy razem niezależnie od poziomu wytrenowania!
Po ukończonym evencie, jeśli jechaliście z nami pierwszy raz, w Waszym wirtualnym garażu będzie czekała nasza teamowa koszulka!

*Ważne! Podczas treningu grupowego każdy z uczestników wykonuje te same bloki treningowe oparte na indywidualnym poziomie FTP wpisanym w swoim profilu.
Ta formuła jazdy pozwala wykonać tez sam trening osobom na różnych poziomach jednocześnie jadąc w tej samej grupie.

TRENUJEMY ZGODNIE Z FIZJOLOGIĄ

Program opiera się na zasadach periodyzacji, progresji obciążeń i odpowiedniego dawkowania bodźców treningowych.

Rozpoczniemy od rozwoju wytrzymałości tlenowej, wspierając adaptacje mitochondrialne,
zdolności oksydacyjne mięśni i efektywność metabolizmu energetycznego. Wraz z postępem okresu przygotowawczego
będziemy stopniowo zwiększać wymagania, przechodząc przez kolejne strefy intensywności – od pracy tlenowej, przez tempo i próg funkcjonalny, aż po wysiłki rozwijające VO2max i potencjał beztlenowy.

AKTUALNE FTP TO PODSTAWA!

Przed rozpoczęciem cyklu zalecamy wykonanie testu FTP i prawidłowe ustawienie stref mocy w Zwift.

Nie zawyżaj FTP i nie wpisuj wartości „na oko” ani na podstawie najlepszych wyników z sezonu. Zimą, szczególnie na trenażerze,
Twoja aktualna moc progowa może być niższa. Prawidłowe FTP pozwala precyzyjnie dozować intensywność i uzyskać zamierzony bodziec fizjologiczny.

PAMIĘTAJ: NIE KAŻDY TRENING MUSI BYĆ MOCNY!

Nasze jednostki mają stanowić wartościowe uzupełnienie Twojego procesu treningowego, a nie cotygodniowy sprawdzian możliwości.
Liczy się jakość pracy, odpowiednia intensywność, regeneracja i długofalowa adaptacja organizmu.

KTO ZA TYM STOI?

Śląsk Kolarsko – społeczność, która od 7 lat integruje kolarzy, organizując wyścigi i wydarzenia kolarskie na Śląsku.
Coffee Ride i inne cykliczne wydarzenia pojawiały się na Śląsku już dawno, dawno temu!

Personalny Trening Kolarski – projekt prowadzony przez Konrada Kopczyńskiego, certyfikowanego trenera kolarstwa UCI,
zajmującego się profesjonalnym przygotowaniem zawodników, indywidualizacją obciążeń i analizą procesu treningowego. Więcej informacji na www.treningkolarski.com

Wszystkie jednostki treningowe przygotowuje osobiście, dbając o ich wartość fizjologiczną i logiczną progresję w całym okresie przygotowawczym.

Trenuj mądrze, systematycznie i z myślą o całym sezonie. Do zobaczenia na Zwift!

name: ZZRC Group Workout
description:
A very warm welcome to our ZZRC Group Workout. 

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

This is banded ride designed to put some structure and FUN into our social rides on Zwift! Each week we will showcase a different Zwift workout. 

The power targets are based on your individual FTP so come join us as we encourage each other to elevate our fitness to new heights on Zwift. 

Join the ZZRC Club on the Companion App, follow us on Facebook, but, most of all, enjoy the ride.

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 17
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #391

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category 
  
 #wtrl #wtrlttt

name: NoPinz R3R - Double Crit 1/2
description:
Welcome to this NoPinz R3R Race. The rules are simple....
Please use ZwiftPower's Minimum Category on your profile for race entry.
Cats A, and B will require a power source (power meter or smart trainer) and heart rate monitor.
Cat C will require power source (power meter or smart trainer) and heart rate monitor for podium spots.
Podium finishers in Cat A are expected to dual (power) record and to make analysis publicly available on ZwiftPower; they must also be using a direct drive trainer or power meter.
**Elite level performances are also expected to be supported by dual (power) recordings from reputable power sources or easily verifiable outside data. This applies to those with a history of such performances.
** 5.2 w/kg (20 mins); 6 w/kg (5 mins); 9.8 w/kg (1 min)
Zwift Activities must be saved publicly.
Please also maintain an open and active Strava profile to facilitate organiser inquiry.
Please see http://www.zwiftpower.com for finalised race results. The race is brought to you by NoPinz please visit https://nopinz.com/product-tag/subzero/ All subzero kit can be custom made in any design.

name: Hexa'Quiz Ride
description:
[FRANÇAIS]
HEXA'Quiz Ride, c'est une compétition sympa où on combine vélo et culture
générale. On pédale tranquillement tout en répondant à des questions sur
l'appli Kahoot! Tous les 4/5 kilomètres, une question arrive. Celui qui
répond bien et vite gagne.

On organise également un classement mensuel pour ajouter un peu de piquant
à l'aventure.

Les questions portent sur divers aspects du cyclisme : les exploits des
professionnels, les différents types de vélos, l'univers virtuel de Zwift,
et tout ce qui touche de près ou de loin à cette passionnante discipline
sportive.

Venez vous amuser et défier vos amis ! Que le meilleur gagne ! C'est le
moment de montrer vos connaissances tout en pédalant !

[ENGLISH]
HEXA'Quiz Ride is a fun competition combining cycling and general
knowledge. You pedal quietly while answering questions on the Kahoot! app.
Every 4/5 kilometers, a question comes up. Whoever answers well and quickly
wins.

A monthly ranking is also organized to add a little spice to the adventure.

The questions focus on various aspects of cycling: the exploits of the
professionals, the different types of bikes, the virtual world of Zwift,
and anything else related to this exciting sport.

Come and have fun and challenge your friends! May the best man win! It's
time to show off your knowledge while you pedal!

name: Coffee Lovers High Time for a Third Place
description:
Have you heard of Third Place? 

We are sure that most of us are attracted to Zwift not only because of the sporting side, but also because of its social component. The opportunity to do something healthy not as a statistician, logging kilometres and hours pedalling, but at the same time enjoying communication, laughing, learning new things, sharing emotions, memories and experiences. Let this event be your Third Place!

name: SZR Group Workout by Thyr
description:
Ride with Mattias Thyr at Ovning.se in courtesy of SZR as he makes workouts for the one who cares and lets him.
Nudging the grit! The home of the unstructured GWOs. Here you got motivating rides together with friends. Skip plans, just a exercise your pixels in a group is good for you, both mentally and physically. Every 6th week we do a #maxtjuga (as we say in Sweden) or a the 20min FTP test together.

On his 8th years and +350 GWO:s he created and lead personally on Zwift. Come join and, "Aim for the stars!

• The workout is approximately 60 minutes long and can be done either fasted or fueled. I personally recommend lots of sugars.
• The goal is to explore and feel the differences between various fueling strategies.
• Remember to adjust your calorie intake to match your energy needs before during and after the session.
• This workout is based on a percentage of your FTP (Functional Threshold Power).
• Ensure your FTP is accurate and up-to-date for the best experience.
• If needed, perform an FTP Test a day before on Zwift prior the workout.
• Use the Zwift Companion App or the Page Up/Down keys on your computer to adjust the FTP bias by 10% up or 25% down, helping you dial in the effort level to suit your preferences.

description:
Come join ZLDR for a nice go AYOP (at your own pace) event. All participants whether running or walking are encouraged to participate. Our leads will be taking this time to walk and chat and basically encourage the heck out of you to just keep moving regardless of your pace!

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. name: Chaser the Pacer!
description:
This is a different type of chase event.

Everyone has to complete one lap of Mountain Mash - only 5.7km.

Every category is led by a Robo Pacer, configured so that their power output is at the top end of the pace group. They are all set up so that they should finish *extremely* closely together.

Jump into your category and try to keep up with the pacer and see how near to the front you finish!

name: Grand Masters League
description:
Welcome to the Grand Masters League! Join passionate cyclists from around the world in this race series designed specifically for competitors of all ages. Each week, we will take on challenging courses in different Zwift worlds, testing your endurance, strategy, and speed.

Rules and Race Format
To ensure fair competition and an epic racing experience, these are the rules you must follow:

Riders will be grouped into age categories to ensure balanced and fair competition:

>     Elite (Cat A) → Up to 29 years old
>     M30 (Cat B) → 30 to 39 years old
>     M40 (Cat C) → 40 to 49 years old
>     M50 (Cat D) → 50 to 59 years old
>     M60+ (Cat E) → 60 years old and up

To appear in the official results on ZwiftPower, it is mandatory to:

Be registered on ZwiftPower.
Use a heart rate monitor (HRM).
Connect a smart trainer or power meter as a power source. (Dual recording is encouraged).

Make sure you meet all requirements to avoid disqualification.

description:

After climbs / descents we will try to focus on getting the back of the group together.

Please always follow ride leader instructions.

name: PUMP: Loop Logic IV — Thursday (4 Laps)
description:
Same Distance. More Laps. Maximum Sass. ♥️🌶️

Welcome to Loop Logic, the weekday series where we prove that "going in circles" is actually a superpower. We’ve curated a week of routes that hit the 19–25km sweet spot with enough climbing to keep your glutes talking back to you.

The Logic is Simple:
We start with one big loop on Monday and add a lap every day until Friday. One lap is a warm-up, but five laps is a statement.

The PUMP Vibe:
Power in Numbers: No band here, ladies! This is your chance to find your rhythm, tuck into a friendly draft, and realize you’re much faster than you think.

Elevation is Our Love Language: Expect at least 100m of climb—just enough to feel the PUMP and earn that post-ride coffee.

Laughter > Watts: We ride hard, but we laugh harder. Whether you’re smashing a PR or just hanging onto a wheel for dear life, do it with a smile.

The Mission:
Show up for yourself, stay for the sisterhood, and let’s show exactly what women-powered logic looks like.

name: Team AMANI's Safari Ride
description:
Team AMANI's Safari Ride is an all category ride, organized by Team AMANI as a training and community engagement tool. Come train with the up and coming talent from East Africa!

Want to ride alongside some of the future stars of the gravel peloton? You've come to the right place! The routes may differ weekly and the rides will be periodically attended by the stars of  Team Amani as well as the future stars from our training facilities in Rwanda (Spoke Academy) and Kenya (the Amani House). We also welcome supporters of Team Amani to join and lead / take part.

So make sure to bring your A-game. There are 3 categories leaving from the start pen and everyone is able to sign-up according to their category and ride with the bunch. Challenge yourself on the segments we come across and make sure to set that PR!

Our goal is to stay as a group during the warming up, work hard at the climbs and regroup on the descents. We will break into a couple of different groups, so find your pace and grab a wheel. If you're feeling strong, pull a few friends across the flats to the hill.

So what is the AMANI Project? The AMANI project brings together initiatives aimed at enhancing access to the sport of cycling and creating opportunities for riders based in  East Africa. Our initiatives are:
- Team AMANI 
- Migration Gravel Race & Safari Gravel
- Amani House & Spoke Academy

Want to learn more or support the cause?

Follow us on our socials:

@teamamani
@spokeacademy

Check out:

https://www.teamamani.com/

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 21
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #391

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category

name: Stage 2 - Race - Tour of Watopia 2026 | Advanced
description:
Once a Year. Twice the XP.

New levels are here, and Double XP is the fastest way to reach them. Take on five epic stages throughout Watopia and earn Double XP along the way. It’s your chance to explore brand-new routes, unlock iconic rewards, and stack bonus XP on top of the Double XP while you’re at it.

STAGE 1
Route: Sand and Sequoias
Distance: 20.1 km // 12.5 miles
Elevation: 175 meters // 574 ft
PowerUps: Feather, Draft
Date: Oct 5—12

STAGE 2
Route: Downtown Eruption
Distance: 19.4 km // 12.1 miles
Elevation: 275 meters // 902 ft
PowerUps: Feather, Anvil
Date: Oct 12—19

Stage 3
Route: Coastal Crown Loop
Distance: 15 km // 9.3 miles
Elevation: 185 meters // 607 ft
PowerUps: Feather, Ghost
Date: Oct 19—26

Stage 4
Route: California Roll
Distance: 33.2 km // 20.7 miles
Elevation: 168 meters // 552 ft
PowerUps: Draft, Aero
Date: Oct 26—Nov 2

Stage 5
Route: Molten Momentum
Distance: 20.8 km // 12.9 miles
Elevation: 245 meters // 804 ft
PowerUps: Feather, Draft
Date: Nov 2—9

MONTHLY GC COMPETITION

Looking for extra motivation? The GC (General Classification) Competition lets you track your progress across all stages. Each race counts—your times add up throughout the series, shaping the overall standings. At the end of the month, the fastest total time takes the win!

VIEW RESULTS: http://zwift.com/racing/leagues/tourofwatopia2026
—------------------
Zwift Racing Score is aimed at pairing you with riders of similar racing abilities to keep racing fun, fair, and competitive. Read the FAQ here: https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh

ADVANCED CATEGORY = 650+
CATEGORY RANGE 1 = 0-159 | 160-269 | 270-389 | 390-509 | 510-649
CATEGORY RANGE 2 = 0-209 | 210-329 | 330-449 | 450-569 | 570-724
WOMEN'S EVENTS = Dedicated women's races available throughout the series.

For riders with a Racing Score of 650 or higher, the' Advanced' category will have separate events scheduled every other hour.

Please note that in order to enter the Advanced category, you will need the following:
Heart Rate Monitor
Zwift Racing Score of over 650
Smart Trainer/Bike or Power Meter

Hourly racing will be split into five tighter categories for more exciting competition. Plus, with hourly alternating category ranges, you’ll have more options to find races that suit your level.

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Mountain Mash | Week 2
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.

Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift

These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder bike choices. 
•	No draft regardless of bike.
•	No Power up’s just you and your watts.
•	Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only 10km, elevation is primary focus.
•	Category enforced, must wear HRM.
•	ZwiftPower league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to zwift power.
•	Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
•	What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has multiple climbs?
•	How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?  

One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing Russian roulette style.

name: ZZRC Soft Spin 1.5 with Andi
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Soft Spin 1.5 with Andi.  This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift.

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.3-1.5. on the ride, with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints, but the average for the whole ride will be 1.5

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced.

In the event of falling off the back of the main group, you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch.

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process.

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club, but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies.

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you.

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group.

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON.

We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel

https://discord.gg/teHeHABDHc

TOP TIPS

Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

Most important of all… HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: EVO CC Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO CC race series.  Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: ZLDR Progression Event
description:
Welcome to our ZLDR Progression Event. Today we’re going to do a progression run, which basically starts a run at a slower pace and finishes at a faster pace than you started. So we’ll get progressively faster with each split. Progression runs help us build our endurance base but with less stress on our bodies than a typical interval or tempo run. This can help reduce the risk of injury. Plus it helps break up the monotony in our training.

Progression running also will help teach you smarter pacing, starting conservatively so you don’t burn out too soon. It also will help train your body to get used to pushing harder at the end of a race.

This event will start with a 10 minute warm up followed by 4 x 5 mins splits. The first split will be at 10k pace and each split will be a stair step up at +2%. Finally we will cool down for 10 minutes. So let’s get those shoes laced up and ready to go!

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are here to support your on-foot dreams and help you develop your running/walking skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners and walkers who want to help you set and achieve new goals!

name: Hotchillee Gain Train
description:
What is it?
Firstly, IT’S NOT A RACE but that doesn’t mean it’s an easy pace no-drop ride. It’s a paced “Category +” Hare and Hounds where you will be working predominately at the upper end of your category and hanging on for as long as you can in search of those gains.

What are the paces?
Paces are based on what the Ride Leader for each group will average and our leaders are pretty accurate - check on ZwiftPower afterwards.   Buffet Class (D+) Leader will average 2.4 w/kg (departs at 1830)
Second Class (C+) Leader average 3.1 w/kg (departs at 1834)
First Class (B+) Leader will average 3.7 w/kg (departs at 1836)

Please do not push the pace faster than this, it ruins it for everyone - respect your Ride Leader, do what they ask and don’t sandbag.

Will the groups catch each other?
Usually we aim for there to be a catch/merge in the final 5km or so but this does depend on the course.
If a merge does happen, stronger riders are encouraged to “upgrade” to the faster group and, if you’re struggling, you can also “downgrade” to a slower one.

What if I get dropped?
Suck it up, maybe find someone to spin home with and try to hang on a bit longer next week - just like a IRL chain-gang, that’s how you get stronger.

Can I push it at the end?
With about 3km to go, your Leader will give a Go! Go! Go! shout and then, if you want, you can empty the tank.

  What is Hotchillee?
Hotchillee is both an events company that organises some of the world's best cycling events and a cycling community. Check out the website for details of events, rides and to get involved www.hotchillee.com

name: Run in the Park Autumn Run League - Week 2
description:
IMPORTANT: You must be registered with ZwiftPower for your result to be included in the official Run in the Park results at www.runinthepark.co.uk

Run in the Park Autumn Run League 2026

Join us for a 6-week Zwift running league with a different route and distance each week.

Each round awards league points based on your finishing position within your group, with your best 5 results from 6 counting towards the final standings.

Choose your group based on your current 5K average pace:

A – Faster than 4:29 min/km
B – 4:29 to 5:00 min/km
C – 5:00 to 5:46 min/km
D – Slower than 5:46 min/km

Please choose your group honestly. Your group should be based on your normal 5K ability rather than the distance or expected pace of that week's race.  Runners exceeding the group threshold maybe promoted to the faster group in the results.

Autumn League routes:

Week 1 – Makuri Islands – Mech Isle Loop – 4.1 km
Week 2 – New York – Shuman Trail Loop – 2.8 km
Week 3 – Paris – Rues in Rythme – 5.3 km
Week 4 – Watopia – Splash and Dash – 6.2 km
Week 5 – Yorkshire – Queen's Highway – 5.6 km
Week 6 – Scotland – Glasgow Crit Circuit – 3.2 km

The league starts on Thursday 8 October, with events scheduled at 2-hour intervals throughout the day.

After the league is decided, Week 7 is the Queen Stage – a special 10 km mass-start finale.

The Queen Stage does not count towards the league standings. All groups start together for one final race, with overall and group honours up for grabs.

6 scoring rounds. Best 5 count. One 10K Queen Stage finale.

name: Old Dog Racing - Masters Tour
description:
Old Dog Racing presents the Masters Tour. A series of shorter and relatively easier races for intermediate level riders.

All races are categorized by age, because to be completely frank, it’s the best racing you can find on Zwift. If you know, you know. And if you don’t you will! Everyone is welcome to race with us, bring some friends and a nemesis or two.

Come and join the fun; A six week tour, Three start times per week, Wednesdays 5:35 pm Eastern; Thursdays 5:35 pm GMT and Fridays 5:35pm Pacific.
Your best finish position each week will count towards your points total.

Races will be mass start and all riders visible, participants will be issued the Zwift Category kit as an aid to identify which category riders you are currently racing against.

The Categories are divided by age as shown below:
A Under 40 (red) B 40-49 (green) C 50-59 (blue) D 60-69 (yellow) and E 70 and over. (purple)

A word of warning; if you haven’t tried age based (masters) racing before, watch out for the yellow and purple jerseys! Those old guys can be surprisingly fast!

Power ups to help you along your way include: The van, the steamroller, the feather, and aero.

Points awarded to each category in every race are: 25, 20,16,13,11,10,9,8,7,6 and 5 very generous participation points!! (You have to finish!). 

Highest accumulated points in each category wins the tour; you’re going to have to wear an HRM and have a Zwift Power account in order to be awarded points.

Overall Tour winner may be eligible to win an Old Dog Racing Mug! (Details on companion club page.).

name: PACK🐺 Social + KOM After Party
description:
Join the PACK and experience a fun social group ride with an average lap pace of around 2w/kg. Everyone is welcome so come and enjoy the friendly supportive atmosphere with late join enabled if you miss the start. The Leader will always be at the correct pace, giving out instructions to help new riders as communication is the key to a good group ride.

After the event finishes, there is an optional fun After Party KOM challenge up the final climb. Ride with others or try to beat your HoloReplay.

All riders will appear in the same PACK kit (unlocks at end) and you can optionally add (PACK) after your name to show support of the group. Please respect the pace set by the leader, this is a group ride not a race. #strongertogether

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 23
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #391

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category

name: FAAST CREW CHAIN GANG!
description:
COME JOIN THE CREW! https://taplink.cc/faastcrew
.
FAAST CREW GROUP RIDES! 🤘
Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday Zwift rides! Everyone is welcome to join… let’s have some fun and get them GAINZ!
.
TUESDAY FTP BUILDER! @ 18:45(gmt)
It’s time to put the work in… each week we will be aiming to push your limits with a workout aimed to boost those FTP numbers…
Come get involved and watch yourself get stronger each week.
.
WEDNESDAY SOCIAL RIDE! @ 18:45(gmt)
Social pace night (banded together)
The main aim of these rides will be to keep things easy and sociable… not only to allow for a wider range of capabilities to get involved… but if you’re looking to get stuck in on Thursdays ride, have yourself an active rest day and use this ride to get to know your riding buddies.
There will also be some “optional” watt bombs being dropped… get involved if you fancy some sprint training!
.
THURSDAY CHAIN GANG! @ 18:45(gmt)
Chain gang night (around 4w/kg)
Come get stuck in and let’s empty those tanks!
This will be a full gas effort… we work as a unit for the most part, let’s try keep things together and help keep the pack strong… and we will operate a sweeper up until the half way mark.
There will however be a sprint finish with results, so the last 5-10minutes it’s every man/woman for themselves. Get stuck in and try take the glory.
This will be a race format but the finish line is an imaginary one as the clock hits zero.
.
LATE JOIN is enabled, so you can join us up to 30 mins after the start time, with the event link.
.
Please help spread the word, invite your pals and be sure to tag us in anything you post… we like to see you suffering, so post on your story of you smashing those pedals and tag @faastcrew.
.
PLEASE JOIN OUR ZWIFT CLUB.
That’s where all the rides will be posted but if you happen to miss them make sure to follow our Instagram page and keep up to date with any upcoming events and announcements.
(All relevant links, click the tap link in bio)
.
We look forward to seeing you all there, come get involved and LET’S HAVE IT!
.
The FAAST CREW.

name: DBR Thursday Race
description:
Welcome to DBR Thursday Race.
All will start with 1 minute between RS categories. Expect each race to be highly competitive and have fun.
Categories
Each race will be using Zwift Racing Score (ZRS) for categorization.
race up a category, if your RS is at the top end of a category. Or if you simply desire an added challenge.
- A: 1000 =< 690
- B:690<520
- C:520<350
- D:350<180
- E:180<=0
Your Zwift Racing Score is determined by how much success you have in races.
better against people with higher ZRS, then your ZRS may increase. If you place worse than people with lower ZRS, then your score might decrease. Read more about ZRS here - https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh <https://support.zwift.com/en_us/racing-score-faq-BkG9_Rqrh>
If your ZRS increases past a category boundary during the series, your points earned will not transfer to the new category with you.
RULES:
Smart trainer or power meter is required. zPower will be removed.
Heart rate monitors are compulsory for all categories.
No TT bikes unless it's a TT event.
You need to have a registered account with Zwiftpower.com and accept their terms and conditions to be in the results of the race.
Misc.
Race organizers may request riders in all categories to provide a dual recording or a matching RL effort (Strava) in order to verify a Zwift race effort. Failure to comply may result in disqualification from the event. Failure to provide a dual recording or RL effort on three requests may result in disqualification from future events, until a dual recording with a matching effort is provided.
Race organizers may exclude a rider from the results, due to poor sportsmanship. Examples may be bad language, sandbagging or other behavior of a disruptive manner.

Welcome to CSPT; a cycling and running club with a difference. It's a place where members can meet up & have fun without any pressure to perform.

name: Renegade Race
description:
Renegade Race is intended to bring out your inner renegade.. Be fearless
and go for the brake away.

Challenge your opponents with fearless cycling.

We encourage you to race Clean with your true weight, so we all have a hard
and fair race every time we mount the bikes.

climbs and fast middle sections.

heart rate monitors, riding an an inappropriate category,
or riding very unrealistically will be disqualified. Final results will be
available on zwiftpower.com.

name: NO LIMIT CC - SUPER SOCIAL
description:
👥 No Limit Cycling Club is a community-led cycling club built around consistency, confidence, and riding together. Riders of all backgrounds and abilities are welcome.

💬 Super Social Thursdays are steady group rides designed to reset after the day. The ride is social and relaxed, with space to chat, sit in the draft, or simply enjoy riding together.

🗺 Routes rotate across Zwift worlds including Watopia, France, and Makuri Islands to keep rides fresh and fun.

🧭 Ride leads manage pacing and communication. Sweepers support riders at the back and help with regrouping when needed.

🔒We warm up around 1.5 w/kg, then settle into 1.8–2.2 w/kg. Fence is on to keep the group together and may be lifted towards the end.

name: Bens Bash
description:
Training ride open to all. The aim of these rides is to provide a regular training ride for all to join in, riding at a steady pace that for some will feel challenging but over time you will get fitter and more comfortable.

Be mindful of your pace and try to keep the group together rather than just ride off on your own - look at this as a way to improve your fitness as well as pick up some skills around riding with others. 

Try not to ride over 3.5 w/kg but if you are feeling frisky - feel free to open the taps with 10 mins to go. 

We will vary the routes so check back regularly.

This is a race with a difference. The slowest riders will start first with a time advantage over the fastest riders and race up to the top of the climb.  To make it fair, each Category’s advantage will decrease slightly, over the next.

The objective is to ride hard and try and reach the top of the climb, before being caught. This is a unique event because do you form a group and work together on the climb, or do you strike out alone? These decisions will impact the outcome.

Rules:
Heart Rate monitor required and Zwift Power for official results.

More information:
For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home

To record all your training data and chart your progress, consider using the TrainingPeaks app or Vekta by following the link https://joinvekta.com/

name: Poursuite de la Lanterne Rouge p/b Velos
description:
Looking for a fun and well supported social ride that will make you stronger? Then join us on Poursuite de la Lanterne Rouge! This event is great for confident D riders looking to step up to something a bit faster, as well as experienced riders who want to test themselves at race pace. We ride together for 45 minutes at 23mph/38kph (2.3w/kg), have a KOM to conquer then a Sprint to warm the legs, then we unleash our Red Beacon to step on the gas and - after a little head start to give our Lanterne Rouge a fighting chance - anyone game for a chase is free to fly. Three chase groups are offered with 3-6 minute deficits to close, and you are guaranteed to get stronger with each attempt to catch! The Yellow Beacon leader will continue at the listed pace the full hour to help those who don’t fancy a chase finish in friendly company. Strong sweep support is available for anyone needing a wheel get back into the leader’s group.
Join our social group at: www.teamvelos.co.uk

name: Zwift Women's Training Club Workout
description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way! 

Join the Zwift Women’s Training Club to connect with new ride friends, ask questions, and get advice from experts.  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ZwiftWTC/join

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides every 3 hours on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays in addition to the Tuesday/Thursday workouts.

name: JOIN x Lanterne Rouge x Zwift: The Indoor Series 2.0
description:
After the great success of our first series last year, we're excited to bring JOIN x Lanterne Rouge x Zwift: The Indoor Series back for another season! Every week, experience the thrill of a group workout or race, culminating in a grand Gran Fondo. Participate in individual events, or elevate your game by following the entire training plan on JOIN, where each weekly event seamlessly integrates into your flexible and adaptive training schedule. If you rode with us last year, keep an eye on your numbers — you'll see your improvements reflected as we tackle many of the same routes and challenges again. Don't miss out on this exhilarating journey. JOIN us and ride to greatness!

We're in it together: 3 rounds of VO2max pyramids with 2 minute steps. Every step you add 10% of your FTP until the top, then the power will decrease every step with 10% of your FTP. Between the pyramids you have 5 minutes rest.

For a deeper dive into our world, coast over to https://join.cc/zwift. Ride on!

name: Zwift Racing League Recon Ride (Team Not Pogi)
description:
This ZRL Group Recon Ride is led by Team Not Pogi (https://www.zwift.com/clubs/935a20fb-fe74-480c-9fdc-7b8ae0af0fb3).

Zwift Racing League Group Recon Rides are the official non-competitive Group Rides. Each one is hosted/run by a participating club and will feature racing tips and tricks for the race ahead, an opportunity to ask questions relating to Zwift Racing League and to preview the full course for Tuesday’s ZRL races.

THE AIM
With experienced ride leaders and Zwifters from a reputable Zwift Club, this is your opportunity to ask questions about all things ZRL-related. You'll be able to learn useful course and team tactics and if you are new to ZRL - perhaps even find a team to race with too!

There are multiple Group Recon Rides to choose from each day at various times and each will operate at the advertised paces (pace is based on your Zwift Pace Group).

WHAT IS THE ZRL?
Introducing the spectacular Zwift Racing League (ZRL) - a turbocharged online bike racing extravaganza that's rewriting the rules of competition. With a staggering 180 community divisions, 1,800 electrifying teams, and a whopping 14,000 fierce racers per 6-week round, the ZRL stands as the undisputed heavyweight champion of online bike racing competitions worldwide.

This high-octane spectacle is masterfully orchestrated by our powerhouse partners, WTRL, who leave no stone unturned in delivering an unparalleled racing experience. But remember, this race is an invitation-only affair, so if you dare to join the ranks of speed demons and thrill-seekers, you'll need to hitch a ride with one of the esteemed existing teams. Fear not, though, for WTRL's website (www.WTRL.racing) is your portal to all the insider intel - schedule, rules, and even a team that perfectly aligns with your fiery spirit!

If you want to gather your own team, you register for the next Round of ZRL at www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/.

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 24
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #391

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category 
  
 #wtrl #wtrlttt

name: Liv Velocity Social Ride
description:
Winter is coming — and the colder days have arrived!

Let’s keep those wheels turning together!

Let’s make these winter weeks fun, cozy, and full of great miles together! 🚴‍♀️✨

name: UK Armed Forces Cycling Community Race Night
description:
We are back being "in the chop" is an Aussie expression that you won't read about in the UCI rulebook. It's one of the many nuances of bike racing that only comes with experience.

Sometimes when you're in a race and find yourself in the final break-away bunch you might get asked "are we in the chop?" or "are we chopping it?". This is referring to collusion between the lead riders to work together until the finish. Many times a break-away will be doomed in the final kilometres because everyone starts playing cat and mouse, attacking, sitting up, etc.

But all that goes out the window in the last lap. This is generally where the group comes together and the final push begins. Working together goes out the window and is every man or woman for themselves for the final sprint to the line.

The Chop is a flat fast time-based handicap race. Do you always get blown out the back on the start of a multi grade race trying to hang onto the guy going with A grade pushing 5w/kg. Well not on The Chop. Released in Grades there are time splits from D to A with the intention of all coming together at the end for the big finish. Each Grade wears a different Zwift kit making each grade easily identifiable on who's wheel you want to catch if they go past.

Races happen on Tuesday evenings. We plan to add further races in the future. No single race has been the same. Many variables are at play on The Chop including course (which is generally a flat course), race numbers, and the inevitable sandbaggers. It has been called a team time trail and cat and mouse but the real racers know it only as "THE CHOP". Do you have what it takes to take the glory?

New to running, coming back after some time off, or simply want a nice warm up or cool down session? Join us as we spend 30 minutes moving the legs in this slow-paced, social event. The goal of the event is to encourage folks to move. 

The leader will average 8kph (7:30min/km) // 5mph (12min/mile) and we encourage runners to go at their own pace if the average pace is too fast and/or use a run/walk strategy.

FULL DESCRIPTION

New to running, coming back after some time off, or simply want a nice warm up or cool down session? Join us as we spend 30 minutes moving the legs in this slow-paced, social event. The goal of the event is to encourage folks to move. 

The leader will average 8kph (7:30min/km) // 5mph (12min/mile) for the duration and it is expected everyone will stay together. This is a timed event, so we encourage runners to go at their own pace if the average pace is too fast and/or use a run/walk strategy.

**Note: if you utilize a run/walk strategy, please start with the walking portion so that you are not overrunning the group on each interval.**

Put your black and orange tops and socks on and let's get moving!

description:

name: RollCo: The Ascent
description:
⛰️ Your ascent. Rise together.

What is The Ascent?
The Ascent is Rolling Collective’s weekly climbing-focused ride, built around shared effort and individual pacing. It’s a space to work through long climbs alongside others, drawing motivation from the group while riding your own line to the top.

The Ride:
Each week focuses on sustained climbing and elevation. Every other week, The Ascent takes on Alpe du Zwift, giving riders the opportunity to work toward the 25× Alpe Climb achievement as part of a regular, supported routine.

Pacing & Expectations:
Riders are encouraged to climb at their own pace, managing effort and intensity individually. Expect company on the road, encouragement in the chat, and the shared satisfaction of finishing together, wherever that may be on the climb. If you’re looking for a pacer, they can often be found on our discord or club chat.

Why Join Rolling Collective?
All RollCo events are open for any rider, club or non-club, we don’t care who you ride for, just that you’re here for the roll! We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

name: JETT Base Ride (2.7~4.5w/kg)
description:
Welcome to Japan eSports Tempting Team BASE Ride !
 Power :
A group- ave 4.0w/kg～4.5w/kg  
B group- ave 3.3w/kg～3.9w/kg  
C group- ave.2.7w/kg～3.2w/kg
Of course, ZWIFTer of all countries can participate. Riders who are hard at the above power should try grouping by using drafting well. 
If you leave the group behind, please offer with "HELP !!" and ZWIFT CAHT. Sweeper goes for support. Sweeper will not go for support unless he offers "HELP !!". Also, please offer within 10 seconds of time difference as much as possible.

Rule of this group ride 
· You always keep grouping in mind( this is not a race )
· Do not Lead from Leader - yellow beacon 
· Power Ups allowed ( do not use final Sprint )
· TT Bike allowed 
· Sprint is the last lap. (Do not sprint other than the last lap) 
Durable base training of about 110 minutes. Follow the leader's instructions, let's work together and make the best group, the best workout!

Japan eSports Temtping Team BASE RIDE !
A group- ave 4.0w/kg～4.5w/kg  
B group- ave 3.3w/kg～3.9w/kg  
C group- ave.2.7w/kg～3.2w/kg

 このグループライドのルール
・常にグルーピングを心がけること(レースではありません）

name: EVO CC Sprint Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO sprintrace series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: WMZ Sugar & Spice
description:
Tired of Zwift Group rides starting at 8w/kg+?

Looking for an active recovery with an optional hit-out to stretch the legs? Sugar & Spice could be just what you’re looking for.

Starting with 2 laps of the 11.3km London course at a recovery pace S&S focuses on keeping together at a modest power (2.2w/kg) and high cadence to promote active recovery.

The third and final lap is an optional race, start the lap behind the ride leader then go as hard as you like.

If you don’t fancy racing continue at the same pace as part of the grupetto.

Finish the ride in any position to earn the WMZau Killer Bees kit.

name: Run in the Park Autumn Run League - Week 2
description:
IMPORTANT: You must be registered with ZwiftPower for your result to be included in the official Run in the Park results at www.runinthepark.co.uk

Run in the Park Autumn Run League 2026

Join us for a 6-week Zwift running league with a different route and distance each week.

Each round awards league points based on your finishing position within your group, with your best 5 results from 6 counting towards the final standings.

Choose your group based on your current 5K average pace:

A – Faster than 4:29 min/km
B – 4:29 to 5:00 min/km
C – 5:00 to 5:46 min/km
D – Slower than 5:46 min/km

Please choose your group honestly. Your group should be based on your normal 5K ability rather than the distance or expected pace of that week's race.  Runners exceeding the group threshold maybe promoted to the faster group in the results.

Autumn League routes:

Week 1 – Makuri Islands – Mech Isle Loop – 4.1 km
Week 2 – New York – Shuman Trail Loop – 2.8 km
Week 3 – Paris – Rues in Rythme – 5.3 km
Week 4 – Watopia – Splash and Dash – 6.2 km
Week 5 – Yorkshire – Queen's Highway – 5.6 km
Week 6 – Scotland – Glasgow Crit Circuit – 3.2 km

The league starts on Thursday 8 October, with events scheduled at 2-hour intervals throughout the day.

After the league is decided, Week 7 is the Queen Stage – a special 10 km mass-start finale.

The Queen Stage does not count towards the league standings. All groups start together for one final race, with overall and group honours up for grabs.

6 scoring rounds. Best 5 count. One 10K Queen Stage finale.

description:

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 26
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #391

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category

name: CC Rider | Social 1.8-2.0 W/kg
description:
Welcome to the CC Riders Afternoon Ride!

Join us for a 60-minute social ride with two pace options. Category D targets 1.8–2.0 W/kg, with riders generally averaging 20 mph or faster. Category E is for riders looking to maintain an average speed below 20 mph. name: Rhino Racing Workout Thursday
description:
RHINO RACING CLUB — THURSDAY WINTER WORKOUT SERIES

After a great first winter, Rhino Racing Club is bringing the series back starting Oct 15 — another 20–22 weeks of progressive Zwift training to help us build fitness through the winter and come into spring stronger.

Sweet Spot — 8 weeks | Oct 15–Dec 3

Threshold — 6 weeks | Dec 10–Jan 14

VO₂ Max — 6–8 weeks | Jan 21–March

We’ll generally follow a 3-week build + 1-week recovery rhythm. The goal isn’t to smash ourselves every Thursday — it’s to build fitness progressively, stay consistent and train together through the winter.

Every Thursday is a structured, banded Rhino Racing Club group workout, so different abilities and FTPs can ride together. Our Yellow Beacon will keep the group together and provide cues throughout the ride on pacing, effort and the purpose of each workout.

First 4 weeks:

• Oct 15 — Tempo Kick-Off

• Oct 22 — Sweet Spot 3 × 8 min

• Oct 29 — Sweet Spot 3 × 12 min

• Nov 5 — Recovery Week

The workouts are selected from the Fast Cat Coaching training library, which includes more than 600 workouts and 100 training plans during its 30-day trial.

Whether you’re racing, training for an event, building fitness or just looking for a supportive group to train with this winter — come ride with the Rhinos.

If you’re training for a spring event or getting ready for the 2027 season, this series is a great weekly session to complement your training plan. Add your endurance work, recovery and strength sessions around it, and you’ve got a solid winter foundation.

You bring the legs. We’ll bring the suffering. 😈🦏

🔗 https://www.zwift.com/uk/events/tag/rhinoworkout

Consistency wins. See you Thursday! DM if you have questions or help lead

name: Run in the Park Autumn Run League - Week 2
description:
IMPORTANT: You must be registered with ZwiftPower for your result to be included in the official Run in the Park results at www.runinthepark.co.uk

Run in the Park Autumn Run League 2026

Join us for a 6-week Zwift running league with a different route and distance each week.

Each round awards league points based on your finishing position within your group, with your best 5 results from 6 counting towards the final standings.

Choose your group based on your current 5K average pace:

A – Faster than 4:29 min/km
B – 4:29 to 5:00 min/km
C – 5:00 to 5:46 min/km
D – Slower than 5:46 min/km

Please choose your group honestly. Your group should be based on your normal 5K ability rather than the distance or expected pace of that week's race.  Runners exceeding the group threshold maybe promoted to the faster group in the results.

Autumn League routes:

Week 1 – Makuri Islands – Mech Isle Loop – 4.1 km
Week 2 – New York – Shuman Trail Loop – 2.8 km
Week 3 – Paris – Rues in Rythme – 5.3 km
Week 4 – Watopia – Splash and Dash – 6.2 km
Week 5 – Yorkshire – Queen's Highway – 5.6 km
Week 6 – Scotland – Glasgow Crit Circuit – 3.2 km

The league starts on Thursday 8 October, with events scheduled at 2-hour intervals throughout the day.

After the league is decided, Week 7 is the Queen Stage – a special 10 km mass-start finale.

The Queen Stage does not count towards the league standings. All groups start together for one final race, with overall and group honours up for grabs.

6 scoring rounds. Best 5 count. One 10K Queen Stage finale.

name: AATC Thursday Interval Workout
description:
WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Dana of the Ann Arbor Triathlon Club - Group workouts make training so much more fun. The Ann Arbor Triathlon Club promotes the sport of triathlon in Southeast Michigan. We have all levels of Triathletes.  

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.

HELPFUL HINT

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. 

For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone 28
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #391

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category

name: RO4H "Aaahh, Thursday!" Social Ride
description:
Welcome to the RO4H “Aaahh, Thursday!” Social Ride.

The RO4H “Aaahh, Thursday!” Social Ride is a social group ride hosted by the Ride On 4 Health community. We foster a friendly, casual, supportive, and respectful atmosphere that embraces everyone from the most seasoned Zwifter to the first-time group ride participant.

The pace varies depending on the terrain, but the ride will have an overall average pace of around 18–20 MPH (27–32 KPH). The pace on the flats sections will be slightly faster in the peloton and be sub 2 W/KG on climbs. We typically ride mostly flat routes with only a few short hills, if any. Sometimes we take on some slightly hillier routes for variety, but most of our rides will be gently rolling to flat terrain.

We try to be a no-drop ride, but ultimately, this pace is a recovery pace for some and a great effort for others. You should be prepared to meet the average pace and strive to stay in the ride leader's peloton to benefit from the group draft effect. Being a social ride, we don’t chase flyers — but flyers are free to fly. The “Aaahh, Thursday!” Social Ride is certainly not a race.

Sweepers are available to assist those off the back. We do not want anyone to ride alone unless they choose. The sweepers will variably help riders bridge to the leader's peloton or form a second pace group. We do not want riders to ride alone unless they want to.

Join us for the RO4H “Aaahh, Thursday!” Social Ride —you'll almost certainly break a sweat, hear a few dad jokes, and might even have fun.

View the RO4H ride schedule: https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/ro4h

Look us up on FB: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ZwiftRideOn4Health/

name: Faster Masters A/B/C Team Pursuit
description:
Thursdays’ Team Pursuit includes three teams starting at different times. Team C will start first followed by Team B, with Team A departing last. The goal is for the faster teams behind to catch Team C during the ride while all three teams hold their respective advertised paces. Starting time gaps may be adjusted during the season to maintain the ride concept, that being: as faster teams catch the team(s) in front, the catch will offer riders in a slower group who wish to increase their effort to do so by joining the faster team as they pass. Additionally, the catch offers riders in the faster team(s) the opportunity to jump in with the slower team(s) and recover to the finish. Riders who jump onto a faster team may realize they cannot hold the pace have an option to fall back to their starting group and try the same the next week to see if they can hold on longer. This is a great way to get stronger riding in a team format. 

All rides include a 30-minute Late Join period. During this time, dropped riders can use Late Join to rejoin their team. If you find that the team you selected is either too fast or too slow for your pace, you can switch teams within the first 30 minutes of the start time of the team you would like to join by using Late Join. 

We do not sweep during the first 30 minutes of a ride. If you fall behind for any reason during this time, we recommend using Late Join. We usually do not have designated sweepers (Red Beacon). After the first 30 minutes, if you get dropped and want to rejoin your team, please send a message in the format HELP(X), where X is the number of seconds you are off the back (for example, HELP5). If you reach out early, one or more stronger riders may come to assist you. If a sweep is needed we recommend you message help within 10 seconds.

We look forward to having you join us. The team pursuit is an excellent endurance and strength building adventure. 

Connect with Faster Masters on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/groups/2286721591625605

name: Phoenix Rising - KNIGHT RIDE (banded)
description:
Welcome to PHOENIX RISING KNIGHT RIDE. This is a 60-minute banded ride where the whole group will stick together as long as you are pedaling. We generally ride on average 1.5 WKG. Some may have a higher WKG up front pulling the band, you are welcome as well. Get a burn in those legs!!!!! We also have a sweep team at your disposal in case you fall out of the band. We are not racers but conquerors, an inclusive and dedicated group striving to help riders achieve their goals through teamwork, friendships and most of all unwavering support. Our rides are about the journey. We have a special bond with all those who join. We expect everyone to be treated with respect. Empathy and tolerance are appreciated as others will have differing views. Stay focused on what unites us: cycling and Zwift. Practice kindness. Please join our team every Thursday!

For more information on all our weekly events, join our club Phoenix Rising on Zwift Companion.
